title: Classify four-role two-pattern pools and full flags
body:
Classifies all 4,964 two-dimensional spaces generated by off-diagonal patterns of four-role binary rank-one idempotents. There are 4,892 full-flag pools and 72 reducible nonflag pools in two symmetry orbits; none is irreducible. This adds the missing two-realized-pattern domain to PR1733 and supplies explicit full binary flags for all 196 of its fully-realized planes, including 20 that are cyclic in coordinate order. Credits and exact predecessor pins are retained.

Validation: Python 3.12.14 registered optimized replay passes, including an independent dense 65,536 matrix projector oracle, all 65 invariant subspaces, 315 flags, W3 regression and source/domain controls. Selected-record integrity and git diff checks pass.

Finite scalar classification only: no complete rational two-relation word, physical supplier, cold replay or new kappa. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. [Coordinated research batch](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18922638); round 06. The selected record is unchanged.
